title: A Primer on Causal and Statistical Dataset Biases for Fair and Robust Image Analysis
benchmark_measurement: The paper does not analyze aspects of religion or faith. Its focus is on causal and statistical biases in medical image analysis concerning attributes like age, sex, and race.
findings: The paper does not contain any findings related to religion or faith, as its focus is on causal and statistical biases in medical image analysis concerning attributes like age, sex, and race.
